newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - April 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - April 15.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

The Environment Agency is in discussions with key water companies to decide upon urgent moves to combat dwindling water supplies. With no end in sight for what is the longest dry spell in 200 years, water firms are currently in favour of a simultaneous phasing in of restrictions.
- MURDOCH'S SON'S BIGGER ROLE AT NEWS CORP

Much interest has been shown in the succession of power at Murdoch's News Corporation. His 25 year old son who has been managing director of News Corp's Australian operation was today appointed executive chairman.
- MARKET PEAK IN BALANCE FOR FUND MANAGERS
According to a Reuters survey fund managers opinions are evenly divided on whether the stock market will peak within the next three months.
- MEPC BUILDS UP ITS SHARE DOWN UNDER

Britain's second largest property company, MEPC is interested in acquisitions. MEPC's Australian branch now has a portfolio of around 800mn Australian dollars (386mn stg) and is looking to develop further.
